name: Aby
source:
A street kid living in the Forbidden Zone.

After his brother is killed and Aby himself is abused and force-fed drugs by Zacharia, Greg finds him and takes care of him.

Aby has a mouthy attitude, but is very loyal towards his friends. He does not have a gem.
